title: Gionatan Nese — sphere of billboard cards with a caption at the bottom
note: The cards sit on a sphere about 480px across and always face the camera, so the sphere reads as a flat cloud with depth from size and overlap. It turns on its own; wheel and drag push it, and it eases back. Hovering a card turns the cursor into a pointer and slides up a caption at the bottom centre: the name in LayGrotesk 14px and the category in Teodor 15px, side by side ("Palm92  Brand Identity"). The card nearest the centre swaps its image every few frames, a little slideshow inside the cloud. Close to the kit's orbit-gallery sphere shape; the bottom caption and the centre slideshow are the parts it lacks.
